about_us:
Strategic Automation Services provides control system solutions for plant expansions, system upgrades, and new facilities.  We offer services to scope and document project requirements, develop system architecture, procure and assemble system components, design and configure regulatory, advanced, and safety controls, support system installation, startup & commissioning, and train operations and support staff on the use and maintenance of the new/modified system.

Our staff work with most major Distributed Control Systems (DCS), Triconex SIS products, Wonderware and Clear SCADA HMIs, most major Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), and a myriad of intelligent networked measurement and control devices.  When it comes to integrating all of the various components that comprise a complete control solution, no one does it better than SAS.

In addition to designing and implementing basic regulatory process controls, we also implement advanced control strategies.  These advanced controls are often configured within the DCS environment, making it easier for client staff to support.  Examples of some of the advanced controls we have delivered include:  Heater Pass Balance, Fired Heater Combustion control, Industrial Boiler Combustion control, Advanced Level control, Three Element Steam Drum Level control, and Compressor Control (Anti-surge, Performance control, Load Balancing for Multiple Compressors, Automated Start/Stop Based on Load).   On many occasions, we can improve process performance by tuning existing controls, or by modifying existing controls to better respond to process dynamics.

The majority of our business comes from long-term, repeat customers.  Our ongoing success, is in no small part, due to the quality of service we deliver to our clients, and the 40+ years of experience we bring to their project team. Whether you need a completely new control system, or just want to get more out of your existing system, Strategic Automation Services can help.
specialties: Manage, Design, Implement, & Install Control Systems, Reverse Engineer & Document Existing Controls, Analyze and Tune Existing Controls, Design & Implement Advanced Controls, Develop High Performance Operator Graphics, Triconex SIS Design and Configuration, DCS Design and Configuration, and PLC Design and Configuration
